newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Oct industry employment barely changed-IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Oct industry employment barely changed-IBGE.

text.p: Employment levels in Brazil's industrial sector were practically stable in October, slipping 0.1 percent from September, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said in a statement.
But against October 1995, the drop was a more significant 8.8 percent, it added.
On a cumulative basis, the drop has been 11.7 percent in January to October 1996 and 11.3 percent in the last 12 months.
Total salaries paid in October rose 0.6 percent, interrupting a series of negative results since June.
Between September and October, the average salary rose 0.7 percent and while in the January to October accumulated period, the increase was 4.8 percent.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
